## Highlights

- Container engine selection is validated: choosing an unavailable engine disables builds and shows a concise installation hint.
- The support-scope information box is localized in all five READMEs.

## Changes

- Validate the selected Podman/Docker engine and disable the build button when it is missing.
- Show distro-aware installation commands, including Docker service startup and the Ubuntu/Mint universe hint.
- Explain the support scope consistently in EN, DE, TR, ES and FR.
- Carry over the package-content verification and repository-cache fixes from alpha.30.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hyalcin70/git2pkg/compare/v0.2.0-alpha.30...v0.2.0-alpha.31
